clip.tooltip: The CLIP model used for encoding the text.

auto_tile_size.tooltip: Auto size based on height and width, default is half the size

enable_vae_tiling.tooltip: Drastically reduces memory use but may introduce seams

tile_sample_min_height.tooltip: Minimum tile height, default is half the height

tile_sample_min_width.tooltip: Minimum tile width, default is half the width

end_percent.tooltip: End percentage of the steps to apply Enhance-A-Video

start_percent.tooltip: Start percentage of the steps to apply Enhance-A-Video

weight.tooltip: The feta Weight of the Enhance-A-Video

enable_tiling.tooltip: Enable tiling for the VAE to reduce memory usage

image_cond_latents.tooltip: Latent to use for image2video conditioning

samples.tooltip: init Latents to use for video2video process

enable_sequential_cpu_offload.tooltip: significantly reducing memory usage and slows down the inference

model.tooltip: These models are loaded from the 'ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models' -folder

rel_l1_thresh.tooltip: Cache threshold, higher values are faster while sacrificing quality

enable_sequential_cpu_offload.tooltip: significantly reducing memory usage and slows down the inference

precision.tooltip: official recommendation is that 2b model should be fp16, 5b model should be bf16

quantization.tooltip: enabled casts the transformer to torch.float8_e4m3fn, fastmode is only for latest nvidia GPUs and requires torch 2.4.0 and cu124 minimum

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent images in the batch.

height.tooltip: The height of the latent images in pixels.

width.tooltip: The width of the latent images in pixels.

crop.tooltip: 0 will do the default center crop, this is a workaround for the widget order changing with the new frontend, as in old workflows the value of this widget becomes 0 automatically

cfg.tooltip: The Classifier-Free Guidance scale balances creativity and adherence to the prompt. Higher values result in images more closely matching the prompt however too high values will negatively impact quality.

denoise.tooltip: The amount of denoising applied, lower values will maintain the structure of the initial image allowing for image to image sampling.

model.tooltip: The model used for denoising the input latent.

negative.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to exclude from the image.

positive.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to include in the image.

sampler_name.tooltip: The algorithm used when sampling, this can affect the quality, speed, and style of the generated output.

scheduler.tooltip: The scheduler controls how noise is gradually removed to form the image.

seed.tooltip: The random seed used for creating the noise.

steps.tooltip: The number of steps used in the denoising process.

audio_vae.tooltip: The Audio VAE model used for decoding the latent.
The Audio VAE model to get configuration from.

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent audio samples in the batch.

img_compression.tooltip: Amount of compression to apply on image.

clip.tooltip: The CLIP model the LoRA will be applied to.

model.tooltip: The diffusion model the LoRA will be applied to.

strength_clip.tooltip: How strongly to modify the CLIP model. This value can be negative.

strength_model.tooltip: How strongly to modify the diffusion model. This value can be negative.

audio.tooltip: Soundtrack to anchor starting at the same frame index, cropped to the video's remaining duration.

audio_vae.tooltip: Audio VAE, needed when an audio is connected.

image.tooltip: Image or video frames to anchor. Multi-frame batches are anchored as a clip and cropped down to the model's valid clip lengths: 5, 22, 39... (17k + 5) frames. Batches shorter than 5 frames use only the first image.

vae.tooltip: Video VAE, needed when an image is connected.

frame_idx.tooltip: Frame index to anchor the image or the clip's first frame at. Negative values are counted from the end of the video.

length.tooltip: Frame count at 24 fps, snapped up to the model's 17k+5 grid (124 = ~5s; trained range is ~124-362, longer is untested)

ref_image.tooltip: Reference image (downscaled to 2048 short edge if larger, never upscaled)

ref_video_audio.tooltip: Soundtrack of the same-numbered reference video

length.tooltip: Frame count at 24 fps, (124 = ~5s, trained range is ~124-362)

ref_image_size.tooltip: Reference image sizing. 'match' scales each ref (down only, keeping aspect) to the generation's pixel area; 'max' uses the reference pipeline's 2048px short edge for best identity fidelity. Reference tokens ride through every sampling step, so 'max' can be several times slower.

batch_size.tooltip: Number of interpolation tasks per GPU call. Higher values improve throughput but use more VRAM. Set to 1 for the most conservative behaviour.

torch_compile.tooltip: Compile the model with torch.compile() for 10-30% faster inference after the first (warm-up) run. Requires PyTorch 2.0+.

filename_prefix.tooltip: The prefix for the file to save. This may include formatting information such as %date:yyyy-MM-dd% or %Empty Latent Image.width% to include values from nodes.

image_interleave.tooltip: How much the image influences things vs the text prompt. Higher number means more influence from the text prompt.

vae.tooltip: The VAE model used for decoding the latent.

temporal_overlap.tooltip: Only used for video VAEs: Amount of frames to overlap.

temporal_size.tooltip: Only used for video VAEs: Amount of frames to decode at a time.
